title: SMTP injection defense in EmailSubmission/set process_create is correct and explicit
description: submission.rs:515-523: check_no_crlf is applied to both mailFrom.email and each rcptTo.email before storing or sending. This is security-critical: CR/LF injection in SMTP envelope addresses can cause header injection attacks. The check is explicit (named function, called twice), documented (RFC 8621 §7.5 referenced), and returns an InvalidRecipients error with a clear description. A contributor might simplify by removing the check for 'efficiency'; that would be a security regression.
